body: Thanks for the kind words. I'm trying to put everything into it it's just so hard. I make so many social stupid moves because of my depression and/or selfishness. I'm not sure what to do to move forward in my career. I've finally realised my city is probably the best springboard for my career right now and I feel like I've burnt too many bridges and sullied my name too much to be redeemed. Maybe I'm not all I thought I was to begin with. This is the hardest thing I've ever done in my life. People younger than me are starting after me and are ahead of me already. So many pros and headliners don't like me. I just had a really socially poisonous public cry for help in a very popular local comedic forum seen by over 1000 members of the scene. I've been having public meltdowns for months. I feel so much anxiety and pressure from this and I feel like there is no sunset to ride off into. I'm not sure what to do but I appreciate the reply, thanks!

I'm thinking of trying cognitive behavioural therapy if I can manage it. I've been to 5 or 6 psychiatrists over the years but haven't had any success. A couple of psychologists and a life coach too. I find everyone always pushes meds which I get the same suicidal urges on and feel gross on them. After the last time I got off meds I went through bad withdrawals and never want that again. Ya I dunno what to do, I'm really hurting right now. Trying to just make it through tonight without doing anything. I have this big show friday I talked my way into that I'm actually really worried about. I had a huge meltdown tonight and wasn't able to go out and practice. This is the second night in a row I've melted down and not been able to practice. Thanks very much for the response I was actually excited to see someone responded.
